test_grpc_python_plugin_stub_attributes: test that the generated gRPC Python module exposes TestServiceStub, TestServiceServicer, and add_TestServiceServicer_to_server
test_unary_rpc_call: test a unary gRPC call by sending a SimpleRequest and verifying the SimpleResponse payload matches expected size
test_streaming_output_rpc: test a server-streaming gRPC call that yields multiple StreamingOutputCallResponse messages with configurable payload sizes
test_full_duplex_streaming_rpc: test a full-duplex streaming gRPC call where client and server exchange messages concurrently via request and response iterators
test_simple_stub_sugar_api: test the simple stub API that allows calling gRPC methods directly without creating explicit channel and stub objects
